newsitem.title: DENMARK: EU monetary committee ends meeting without comment.
newsitem.headline: EU monetary committee ends meeting without comment.

text.p: The European Union's monetary committee ended an informal one-day meeting in the Danish capital on Friday, an economy ministry official told Reuters.
The officials would not say what was on the agenda but said the meeting was routine and attended by senior officials of member states' central banks and finance ministries.
Delegates leaving the Danish Central Bank building where the committee met would not comment on the content of the talks or the agenda.

The committee, which works on the detail of European monetary decisions, normally meets in Brussels but can meet informally and in private elsewhere and generally does so once a year. Last year it met in the Swedish capital, Stockholm.
The Danish official would not say if the meeting was part of preparations for next month's Amsterdam EU summit.

The June heads of state meeting is expected to be overshadowed by clouds over the timing and shape of economic and monetary union caused by the French election and Germany's controversial plan to revalue gold assets.
